embeds.title: v0.8.0 — the rules start moving
embeds.description:
Until now every week ran the same rules. Not anymore.

**NEW — WEEKLY ANOMALIES**
Every season now rides under one rule that bends the whole week. This week:

**Grown Past Use**
Take a rat to **★3** and the shop is done with its kind for the week — no more copies, on board or bench.
You ride with **+1 board slot**, free, all week. Small comfort.

**PVP LEAGUE**
• Nightly duel: **20:00 ⇒ 22:00 CET**
• Win value: **3 ⇒ 2 points** the week's first two nights, back to 3 from the third — the table shouldn't be decided before it's warm.
• Poison now fades as a fight drags instead of biting at full strength forever. The longest duels feel it most. Merging a poison rat still scales; resist still can't cancel it outright.
• Duel replays now end on **VICTORY / DEFEAT / DRAW**.

**BUFFS**
• **Warren-Warden & MD Rattyfock** — line buff: +1/+1 ⇒ **+2/+1**
• **MBP Rat** — attack: 3 ⇒ **4**
• **Squeak-Sensei** — health: 3 ⇒ **4**
• **Grave-Leech** — health: 6 ⇒ **7**
• **Gutter-Acolyte** — health: 3 ⇒ **4**

footer.text: we ride at dawn · season resets monday 06:00 CET
